description: Defines enums, structs, and conversion functions related to PSUP PDU session information, including PDU types, paging policy indicators, and session data structures for downlink and uplink in 3GPP TS 38.415 specifications.

classes.name: psup_dl_pdu_session_information
classes.description: Represents downlink PDU session information with fields for PDU type, QoS indicators, and timestamps.

classes.name: psup_ul_pdu_session_information
classes.description: Represents uplink PDU session information with fields for PDU type, QoS identifiers, delay metrics, and timestamps.

methods.name: psup_pdu_type_to_uint
methods.description: Converts a psup_pdu_type enum to its uint8_t representation.

methods.name: uint_to_psup_pdu_type
methods.description: Converts a uint8_t to its corresponding psup_pdu_type enum.

methods.name: psup_ppi_to_uint
methods.description: Converts a psup_ppi enum to its uint8_t representation.

methods.name: uint_to_psup_ppi
methods.description: Converts a uint8_t to its corresponding psup_ppi enum.
